content.title: What does this expression evaluate to?
content.body:
Two operators, one expression. Decide which one JavaScript applies first, then do the other.

What does this expression evaluate to?

```js
2 ** 3 + 1;
```
content.explanation: ** has higher precedence than +, so 2 ** 3 is evaluated first and gives 8; adding 1 gives 9. 16 would need 2 ** (3 + 1), which the grammar never produces from this line, and 7 comes from reading ** as multiplication.
